Team — forwarding Acme’s constraints. Key points:
- Evelyn (DPO) available before 17:00 CET only, no long-term recording retention.
- Sana (APAC) available 09:00–12:00 JST.

Options I see:
1) Single session anchored in UTC (13:00 UTC) — this hits 15:00 CET (Evelyn ok), and 22:00 JST (too late for Sana).
2) Staggered approach: 2 short windows back-to-back: EU-focused (core demo + EU Qs) at 15:00 CET / 13:00 UTC, then an abbreviated APAC handoff recorded for internal use only + live QA for Sana between 09:00 JST next day.
3) Two full demos (one EU, one APAC) — highest ops overhead but clean for local reviewers.

Recommendations: option 2. That minimizes duplication of engineering time while respecting local windows. We should:
- Offer 15:00–16:00 CET (13:00–14:00 UTC) for EU session (live, no recording retained).
- Offer an APAC live Q&A the following morning at 09:30 JST (00:30 UTC) — short (30 min) to avoid late-hours for our EU folks. Rafael or Laura can run the APAC slot; Karthik to cover the architecture portion in both.

Action: Karthik / Laura can you confirm SME availability for those slots? Soojin, we’ll need a 10‑minute security overview tailored to the DPO concerns for the EU session.

— Marissa
